result:
If I could change the world in one way, it would be to give everyone a deep, reliable capacity for empathy—the ability to truly understand and feel the experiences, fears, and hopes of others.

With that change, many other problems would become easier to address: conflict, inequality, cruelty, and neglect often stem from an inability or unwillingness to see others as fully real and deserving of care. If people could genuinely understand one another, cooperation and compassion would likely grow.
